svg.title: replication and health
svg.desc: With factor two, Set writes B and A. Marking B unhealthy makes A the read owner and A and C the current write set.
svg.text: Replicated routing: write several owners, read the first healthy
Illustrative clockwise physical owners for one key: [B, A, C] | replication factor = 2
All healthy: Set -> B and A; Get -> B
B marked unhealthy: routing selects [A, C]; Get -> A
A already has the value from the earlier write. New writes now go to A and C.
SetNodeHealth changes a manual health flag; there is no network probe.
A cache miss on the first healthy owner is returned directly; Get does not try every replica.
